mission.text1: At Krishak Sarathi, our mission is to empower farmers across India by providing them with accessible, real-time, and AI-driven agricultural insights. We believe that language and technology should never be a barrier to maximizing crop yield and securing fair market prices.
mission.text2: Through voice-first interfaces and localized AI, we bring expert agronomy directly to the hands of the farmers who need it most.
mission.title: Our Mission

story.text: Krishak Sarathi was born out of a simple observation: while agricultural science was advancing rapidly, the average farmer was still relying on outdated information and middlemen to make critical decisions. Our founding team of technologists and agronomists came together to build a platform that talks to farmers in their own language—literally.

q1.answer: Simply tap the microphone button on the Home or Voice Advisor page, speak your query in your local language (e.g., 'What is the price of wheat today?'), and the AI will respond with the answer instantly.

q2.answer: Yes! The core features of Krishak Sarathi, including Voice Advisor, Weather updates, and Market Prices, are completely free for farmers.

q3.answer: Our AI model is trained on thousands of crop images and is highly accurate. However, we always recommend consulting a local agronomist for severe outbreaks.

q4.answer: We support English, Hindi, Gujarati, Marathi, Bengali, Telugu, Tamil, Kannada and Punjabi. You can change your preference using the globe icon in the top header.
